author: GamingBolt
description:
It's not often that a studio spends about seven years working on a side-scrolling action platformer, but Replaced isn't your typical run-and-gun experience. Launching on April 14th for Xbox Series X/S and PC (alongside Game Pass on day one), it's a dystopian odyssey – a desperate crawl through the remnants of once-glorious cities in search of...well, something. 

There's still a lot to unpack, so let's jump into 15 things you should know about it, starting with the most eye-catching part...
title: Replaced - 15 Things You NEED TO KNOW Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
In a landscape filled with cinematic sci-fi blockbusters and formula-driven action games, Pragmata stands out not by rejecting familiar ideas, but by recombining them in a way that feels genuinely fresh. 

The upcoming adventure impresses with its dual-character design, which blends mobility with real-time hacking, making for a fresh mix of real-time and strategic combat. There's also a strong sense of art design at play, and combine that with the inventive gameplay mechanics, and Pragmata becomes pretty hard to ignore in a sea of releases.
title: Why Pragmata Is Going To Be Unlike Anything Out There

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert has managed to take everything that’s good about its peers and weave all of it into an experience that manages to stand out on its own. That’s a rare feat that comes with the pleasure of reminding you of why you fell in love with all the titles it imitates in some form or the other. Skyrim is an obvious addition to any conversation about great open world games and it's especially relevant in Crimson Desert’s case.

Why is that so? Well, that’s what we’re here to answer as we put the two titles together in a very interesting conversation about what makes their respective worlds so compelling. There’s a lot to discuss, along with some very fond memories, so dive right in.
title: Crimson Desert Made Me Feel Like Those Skyrim Days All Over Again
